Context: Steps for Conduct of Inquiry in Complaints of Sexual Harassment

- I. Where a Complaint Committee has not recommended any action against the employee against whom the allegations have been made in a case involving allegations of sexual harassment, the Disciplinary Authority shall supply a copy of the Report of the Complaint Committee to the complainant and shall consider her representation, if any submitted, before coming to a final conclusion. The representation shall be deemed to be an appeal under Section 18 (1) of the Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention,
